integrity: The topological premises were independently checked in the primary full text, and the finite F3 calculation was replayed from the packaged verifier. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The claim determines only the mod-3 first-homology image. It does not determine the integral symplectic image or the full mapping-class-group image. title: The degree-three Xiao monodromy has full Lagrangian unipotent image modulo 3
